trust_decision.summary: Untrusted version/range/comparator strings are matched against regexes with unbounded \s*, \s+, [0-9]+ and [0-9A-Za-z-]+ quantifiers (super-linear backtracking); the decision of how much input a regex may scan is made at regex construction in semver.js and at whitespace normalisation in Range/Comparator constructors. The pinned tree is the v6 branch (single semver.js); of the three fix commits, 928e56d is the one for this branch (2f8fd41 is v5, 717534e is v7).

landing_point.why: The summary says ReDoS in range parsing; an engineer opens the Range constructor, where `range.split(/\s*\|\|\s*/)` and then parseRange (semver.js:941-979) run the trim regexes on raw input.

fix_sites.entry_point: module load; every regex consumer (safeRe built from src via makeSafeRe, fix.diff:894-906)
loose parse / loose ranges (NUMERICIDENTIFIERLOOSE [0-9]+ -> \d+ so it gets bounded)
new semver.SemVer and all compare/inc/major/minor/patch helpers
new semver.Range (raw normalised; split on literal '||')

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All changed sites are in semver.js; the only other module, bin/semver.js, reaches them only through the public API (bin/semver.js:93-123).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Non-whitespace quantifiers ([0-9]+ in loose identifiers, build identifiers) look unrelated to a 'whitespace' ReDoS report, so a solver could argue that only \s* / \s+ needed bounding. The exported raw `exports.re` array (semver.js:30) is deliberately left unbounded by the fix as a 'userland' API (fix.diff:810-815).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate ranges with arbitrary whitespace ('>=  1.2.3', '~ 1.2.3', '1.2.3 - 1.2.4', ' a || b ') and long multi-'||' ranges must still parse to the same normalised string. A length cap on range strings, or rejecting multi-space input, breaks them. Also: Range.raw at the pinned commit keeps the original string, and the fix changes it (and the error text) to the normalised form.

O6_input_shapes: long whitespace runs between comparators in a Range
whitespace between operator and version (COMPARATORTRIM / Comparator)
long digit runs (e.g. 500000 '0's) inside a range, bounded via \d{1,256}
leading/trailing whitespace on SemVer and Comparator input
loose vs strict option variants of each regex

O7_producer.where: The regex table is built at module load (semver.js:246-251) in the same file and is used directly by every check; there is no separate producer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a CLI-side pre-filter or 'range' parsing helper that applies its own whitespace regex (e.g. /\s*\|\|\s*/) to argv before calling semver
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The CLI already does option and argument munging, and a maintainer could plausibly add local range splitting there for output formatting.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a toComparators/simplify-style helper that re-splits Range.raw with its own \s-greedy regex instead of the normalised set
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Later semver versions added simplifyRange/subset helpers working on raw range strings; a helper that reads raw instead of normalised input is a natural mistake.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: clean() extended to strip operator/whitespace prefixes with an unanchored greedy regex such as /^[=v\s]*/ followed by a second \s* group
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: clean() already does ad-hoc regex prefix stripping outside the token table, so it would not pick up safeRe.

O9_family: ReDoS (CWE-1333, super-linear regex backtracking on whitespace/digit runs)

O10_build.project_tests: test/index.js (range/comparator/version tables), test/coerce.js, test/min-version.js, test/gtr.js, test/ltr.js; run with `tap test/ --100 --timeout=30` (package.json:7). The fix adds test/whitespace.js and test/re.js, which do not exist at the pinned commit.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Normalise whitespace in the Range constructor only (or add a length cap on ranges), which leaves Comparator/SemVer input and the unbounded digit and build-identifier quantifiers (the '0'-run variant) open.

out_of_scope_notes: Fix commits 2f8fd41 (v5 semver.js) and 717534e (v7 classes/*, internal/re.js) target other release lines and do not apply to this v6 tree.
unverified: repo_mb not measured; the tree is about 15 JS files with a ~1600-line semver.js, so well under 5 MB (tiny_repo assumed).
Whether the exported raw `exports.re` (semver.js:30) is documented for userland in the README was not checked; the fix keeps it unbounded on purpose, so it is not listed as an O8 route.

O1 counts exported functions that reach the changed regexes (parse, valid, clean, SemVer, Comparator, Range, toComparators, satisfies, maxSatisfying, minSatisfying, minVersion, validRange, ltr, gtr, outside, intersects, coerce, CLI). Compare helpers that construct SemVer are folded into SemVer.
Which exact inputs are super-linear per regex was not run (running the code is not allowed); this rests on the fix's tests (fix.diff:1150-1187).
